items.title: What will Baylor Scheierman do for an encore after a breakout second season?
items.author: Bobby Krivitsky
items.body_excerpt:
What will Baylor Scheierman do for an encore after a breakout second season?

Last year, he showcased how much he can bring to the table on offense and his effectiveness while taking on a high degree of matchup difficulty on defense.
